name: pvliesdonk
description: Claude Code plugins by pvliesdonk: MCP servers for markdown vaults, academic literature and image generation, plus development-workflow tooling.

plugins.name: code-archaeology
plugins.description: Work out what happened and why, from what a project left behind — establishing ground truth before trusting any history query, and refusing to fill a gap with a plausible reconstruction.

plugins.name: github-issues
plugins.description: Two disciplines for GitHub issues: writing one that records an observation rather than a work order, and triaging a backlog within the label scheme that exists rather than redesigning it.

plugins.name: hosting-workshops
plugins.description: Design and facilitate workshops, trainings, retrospectives, design sprints, threat-modeling sessions, and other structured group sessions.

plugins.name: markdown-vault-mcp
plugins.description: Generic markdown vault MCP server with FTS5 + semantic search

plugins.name: open-knowledge-format
plugins.description: Author, validate, migrate and consume Open Knowledge Format bundles — Google Cloud's vendor-neutral spec for agent-readable knowledge as markdown with YAML frontmatter, with a conformance validator.

plugins.name: preflight-circus
plugins.description: A blind six-lens review gate over BASE..HEAD, run before you push rather than after — the same examination a post-push review bot applies, sat while the diff is still local.

plugins.name: refactor-audit
plugins.description: Audit a Python codebase with complexity, churn, smell, and dead-code signals, then rank a focused refactoring triage shortlist without editing the target.

plugins.name: roadmapping
plugins.description: Chart, refine and revisit multi-epic technical roadmaps at a declared resolution, holding the line against false precision about work nobody has scoped yet.

plugins.name: scholar-mcp
plugins.description: FastMCP server for scholarly sources (papers, patents, books, and standards) with metadata enrichment and docling PDF conversion

plugins.name: writing-nonfiction
plugins.description: Draft, structure, and revise nonfiction for real readers across proposals, papers, white papers, blog posts, explainers, handbooks, and software documentation.

plugins.name: paperless-mcp
plugins.description: Paperless-NGX document management over MCP: search, tag, upload, and read documents; manage tags, correspondents, document types, and custom fields.
